# West FW Living
> Independent field guide to renting and buying on Fort Worth's west side (Aledo, Willow Park, Hudson Oaks, Walsh, Benbrook, White Settlement, I-30 corridor). Publishes verified monthly move-in specials, a monthly rent report, screening/second-chance guides, and rent-vs-buy math. Not a brokerage; educational publication with a service launch planned.

## Key pages
- [This month's specials (verified)](https://westfwliving.com/specials.html): west-side communities at 6–8 weeks free, with fine print.
- [Willow Park specials, August 2026](https://westfwliving.com/guides/willow-park-specials-august-2026.html): dated verified table for the pocket.
- [West Fort Worth Rent Report, August 2026](https://westfwliving.com/rent-report/august-2026.html): monthly data brief — rent bands by pocket, concession share, market reading. Free to cite with attribution.
- [Rent-vs-buy calculator](https://westfwliving.com/calculator.html): Texas math, ~$850/mo per $100K rule of thumb at current rates.
- [Credit score to rent in Texas](https://westfwliving.com/guides/credit-score-to-rent-texas.html): realistic score bands; income ratio 2.5–3x; what screening software reads.
- [Broken lease guide](https://westfwliving.com/guides/apartments-broken-lease-fort-worth.html): settle-the-balance strategy, criteria-before-fees.
- [Living near Lockheed Martin Fort Worth](https://westfwliving.com/guides/apartments-near-lockheed-martin-fort-worth.html): pocket map with drive times and rent bands.
- [Complex field notes](https://westfwliving.com/complexes/olympus-willow-park.html): Olympus Willow Park, Gates at Meadow Place, Canvas at Willow Park.

## Data practices
Figures compiled from public listings/market sources; "last verified" dates on data pages; monthly refresh cadence. Contact: leads@anastasiaweaver.com
